The perfect night out
Sep 2026 • Family
We had a fantastic family dinner at Pink Salt Steak & Seafood! We ordered the salmon fish and chips, the steak special, and the pink pasta, and it was the perfect amount of food to comfortably feed our family of three with great variety.
Salmon Fish and Chips: Incredibly fresh and flaky with a light, crispy batter.
Steak Special: Cooked to perfection—tender, juicy, and full of flavor.
Pink Pasta: Rich, creamy, and a huge hit at the table.
The portions are generous and the quality across the board was top-notch. Highly recommended for a family meal!

Thank you for making my husband's dinner special ❤️.
